notes: The 'compatible' build targets GOAMD64=v1, so it runs on every x64 CPU; the plain amd64 build needs AVX2.
Wintun is embedded in this binary (the executable exports WintunCreateAdapter/WintunStartSession), so no separate wintun.dll ships with the installer.
To upgrade: pick a release at https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/releases, download the asset, record sha256 of the zip and of the extracted exe here, then run installer/fetch-kernel.ps1 to confirm.
